**Note 2:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Brain and Cerebral Meninges* chapter on page 272 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=272).
